title: When a Companion Fare Costs More Than Two Regular Tickets
caption:
A companion fare can cost you $50 more. In this hypothetical Alaska comparison, two regular tickets win—using a benefit is not the same as saving money.

Fly Alaska occasionally? Compare actual checkout totals for trips you would willingly take, with similar flight times and the baggage and seats you need. The advertised $122 minimum companion price is not a guaranteed final price—or the total for two travelers.

Skip the redemption when regular tickets cost less and work just as well. Do your own math: practicalrewards.com/calculators/alaska-companion-fare.html
